name: CT_INFSN_DT_HX_AUDIT
description: This table contains the day 0 entry history audit trail for a cell therapy episode. This includes the day 0 dates, the users who updated the day 0, and the update instants.

columns.name: SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the episode record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: INFSN_DT_HX_AUDIT_DATE
columns.description: This item stores the audit trail of the day 0/day 1 date of a cell therapy episode.

columns.name: INFSN_DT_USER_AUD_USER_ID
columns.description: This item stores the audit trail for the users who updated the day 0/day 1 date of a cell therapy episode.

columns.name: INFSN_DT_USER_AUD_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: INFSN_DT_INST_AUD_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: This item stores the audit trail for the instant when the day 0/day 1 date of a cell therapy episode is updated.
